context: Mei and Aoi talk about a moving film.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (涙/笑い/弱い/面倒/気づい) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの映画、涙が止まらなかったの。
lines.en: I couldn't stop crying at that film.
lines.style: soft emotional woman voice, gentle tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私も、笑いと涙で忙しかったよ。
lines.en: I was busy with laughter and tears too.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 主人公が、弱い自分を認める場面ね。
lines.en: The scene where the lead admits his weakness.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そこで、私も気づいたことがあるの。
lines.style: thoughtful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 弱さを見せるの、面倒だけど大事ね。
lines.en: Showing weakness is a hassle, but important.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 笑いの後の涙が、心に残ったよ。
lines.en: The tears after the laughter stayed with me.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 面倒がらずに、また見たいな。
lines.en: Without being lazy about it, I want to watch again.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 大事なことに、気づかせてくれたね。
lines.en: It made us realize something important.
lines.style: tender barista voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
